io.milvus.bulkwriter

Class LocalBulkWriter

  • java.lang.Object
    • io.milvus.bulkwriter.BulkWriter
      • io.milvus.bulkwriter.LocalBulkWriter
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    AutoCloseable
    Direct Known Subclasses:
    RemoteBulkWriter, VolumeBulkWriter

    public class LocalBulkWriter
extends BulkWriter
    BulkWriter that writes bulk data files to the local filesystem.

    Rows are appended into chunked data files under a local directory. When a file reaches the configured chunk size, it is committed and handed to callBack(List).
